subtitle: Lesson 22 · Common Attack Types & Social Engineering

eyebrow: Four techniques, one target: the person
code:
Phishing        Mass, email-based, impersonates a trusted sender
Spear phishing  Same idea, researched and aimed at one person
Pretexting      A fabricated scenario used to extract information
Baiting         Something enticing (a USB drive) that triggers a compromise
caption: None of these exploit a software flaw — all four exploit trust.

steps.label: Phishing
steps.sub: sent to thousands — only needs a small percentage to click
